## Multiplier

Context re-send multiplier: 32,874 / 53,462 = **0.6x** (squad tokens / single-agent tokens). Largest share: "orchestrator -> triage worker", 43% of all squad tokens (14,232 tokens over 23 calls, 83% of them prompt tokens).

Calls Groq rejected (400, no usage reported) are not in these totals: 0 single, 10 squad. Estimating each at its hop's mean call size adds ~0 and ~7,391 tokens, giving an estimated multiplier of **0.8x**. Either way the squad spent fewer tokens than the single agent.
